machinations_of_dominion.text_zh:
本回合你使用的下一张符文剑士攻击行动牌获得压制，以及“若本回合你使用过或创造过一个光环，此牌获得再动。”
再动
machinations_of_dominion.text_en:
The next Runeblade attack action card you play this turn gets overpower and "If you've played or created an aura this turn, this gets go again."
Go again

madcap_charger.text_zh:
作为使用莽撞冲锋者的额外费用，随机弃一张牌。
若被弃置的牌力量为6或更高，莽撞冲锋者具有再动。
madcap_charger.text_en:
As an additional cost to play Madcap Charger, discard a random card.
If the discarded card has 6 or more {p}, Madcap Charger has go again.

madcap_muscle.text_zh:
作为使用莽撞肌肉的额外费用，随机弃一张牌。
若被弃置的牌力量为6或更高，莽撞肌肉获得+3力量。
madcap_muscle.text_en:
As an additional cost to play Madcap Muscle, discard a random card.
If the discarded card has 6 or more {p}, Madcap Muscle has +3{p}.

mage_hunter_arrow.type_zh: 游侠 行动·箭矢 攻击
mage_hunter_arrow.text_zh:
瞬间——摧毁此牌：本回合接下来你将受到秘法伤害时，防止其中3点伤害。仅当此牌在你军械库中正面朝上时才能启动此异能。
当此牌命中符文剑士或法师英雄时，你可以摧毁其控制的一个光环。
mage_hunter_arrow.text_en:
Instant - Destroy this: The next time you would be dealt arcane damage this turn, prevent 3 of that damage. Activate this only while this is face-up in your arsenal.
When this hits a Runeblade or Wizard hero, you may destroy an aura they control.

mage_master_boots.text_zh: 行动——支付1点资源，摧毁此牌：你本回合使用的下一张非攻击行动牌获得再动。再动
mage_master_boots.text_en: Action - {r}, destroy this: The next non-attack action card you play this turn gets go again. Go again

magmatic_carapace.text_zh:
每当你使用光环时，你可以横置此牌并支付1点资源。若如此做，创造一个地震涌动衍生物。
守御
magmatic_carapace.text_en:
Whenever you play an aura, you may {t} this and pay {r}. If you do, create a Seismic Surge token.
Guardwell

magrar.text_zh:
杰尼斯专精
行动——摧毁此牌：创造一个禅定和一个惰性衍生物。
magrar.text_en:
Genis Specialization
Action - Destroy this: Create a Zen State and an Inertia token.

malefic_incantation.type_zh: 符文剑士 行动·光环
malefic_incantation.text_zh:
再动
此牌进入竞技场时带有3个诗节指示物。当其用完时，摧毁它。
每回合一次，当你使用攻击行动牌时，从此牌上移除一个诗节指示物。若如此做，创造一个符文吟唱衍生物。
malefic_incantation.text_en:
Go again
This enters the arena with 3 verse counters. When it has none, destroy it.
Once per turn, when you play an attack action card, remove a verse counter from this. If you do, create a Runechant token.

malign.text_zh:
隐匿
恶意将造成的伤害不能被防止。
malign.text_en:
Stealth
Damage that would be dealt by Malign can't be prevented.

man_overboard.type_zh: 海盗 Necromancer 行动·攻击
man_overboard.text_zh: 当此牌攻击时，你可以弃一个盟友。若如此做，此牌获得+1力量和再动。
man_overboard.text_en: When this attacks, you may discard an ally. If you do, this gets +1{p} and go again.

mandible_claw.text_zh:
每回合一次行动——支付2点资源：攻击
若本回合你弃置过一张力量为6或更高的牌，此牌的攻击获得再动。
mandible_claw.text_en:
Once per Turn Action - {r}{r}: Attack
If you have discarded a card with 6 or more {p} this turn, this card's attacks go again.

mangle.text_zh: 粉碎——当此牌对英雄造成4点或更多伤害时，摧毁该英雄控制的一个带有-1防御指示物的装备。
mangle.text_en: Crush - When this deals 4 or more damage to a hero, destroy target equipment they control with a -1{d} counter.

manifest_muscle.text_zh: 若本回合你创造过一张牌，此牌获得+1力量。
manifest_muscle.text_en: If you've created a card this turn, this gets +1{p}.

manifestation_of_miragai.type_zh: 秘法 幻术师 瞬间·光环
manifestation_of_miragai.text_zh:
此牌进入竞技场时带有两个+1力量指示物。若你为使用此牌资源过一张气，改为此牌进入竞技场时带有四个+1力量指示物。
结界X，X为此牌上的+1力量指示物数量。
manifestation_of_miragai.text_en:
This enters the arena with two +1{p} counters. If a Chi was pitched to play this, instead this enters the arena with four +1{p} counters.
Ward X, where X is the number of +1{p} counters on this.

march_of_loyalty.text_zh: 若本回合你创造过效忠衍生物，此牌获得再动。
march_of_loyalty.text_en: If you've created a Fealty token this turn, this gets go again

mark_of_lightning.text_zh: 每当你控制的闪电或元素攻击被一张来自手牌的牌防御时，你可以摧毁闪电印记。若如此做，该攻击对防御英雄造成1点伤害。
mark_of_lightning.text_en: Whenever a Lightning or Elemental attack you control is defended by a card from hand, you may destroy Mark of Lightning. If you do, the attack deals 1 damage to the defending hero.

mark_of_the_beast.type_zh: 暗影 蛮将 行动·攻击
mark_of_the_beast.text_zh:
若野兽印记将从任何区域置入你的坟场，改为放逐它。
血债
mark_of_the_beast.text_en:
If Mark of the Beast would be put into your graveyard from anywhere, instead banish it.
Blood Debt

mark_of_the_black_widow.text_zh:
隐匿
当此牌命中被标记的英雄时，该英雄放逐其手牌中的一张牌。
mark_of_the_black_widow.text_en:
Stealth
When this hits a marked hero, they banish a card from their hand.

mark_of_the_funnel_web.text_zh:
隐匿
当此牌命中被标记的英雄时，放逐其军械库中的一张牌。
mark_of_the_funnel_web.text_en:
Stealth
When this hits a marked hero, banish a card in their arsenal.

mark_of_the_huntsman.type_zh: 刺客 武器·匕首 （单手）
mark_of_the_huntsman.text_zh:
每回合一次行动——支付2点资源：攻击。再动
当此牌命中英雄时，你可以选择摧毁此牌并标记该英雄。
若此牌正在攻击被标记的英雄，此牌获得+1力量。
mark_of_the_huntsman.text_en:
Once per Turn Action - {r}{r}: Attack. Go again
When this hits a hero, you may choose to destroy this and mark them.
If this is attacking a marked hero, this gets +1{p}.

mark_the_prey.text_zh:
隐匿
当此牌命中英雄时，标记该英雄。
mark_the_prey.text_en:
Stealth
When this hits a hero, mark them.

mark_with_magma.type_zh: 龙裔 忍者 行动·攻击
mark_with_magma.text_zh: 若你控制2个或更多龙裔链环，此牌获得再动，以及“当此牌命中英雄时，标记该英雄。”
mark_with_magma.text_en: If you control 2 or more Draconic chain links, this gets go again and "When this hits a hero, mark them."

marked.text_zh: 你处于被标记状态，直到一位对手命中你。
marked.text_en: You are marked until an opponent hits you

marlynn.text_zh:
行动——横置此牌，摧毁你控制的一个金币：在你的手牌中创造一张金翅鱼叉。再动
每当你在此行动阶段期间抽牌时，你可以将你手牌中的一张箭矢正面朝上放入你的军械库。
marlynn.text_en:
Action - {t}, destroy a Gold you control: Create a Goldfin Harpoon in your hand. Go again
Whenever you draw a card during your action phase, you may put an arrow from your hand face-up into your arsenal.

marlynn_treasure_hunter.text_zh:
行动——横置此牌，摧毁你控制的一个金币：在你的手牌中创造一张金翅鱼叉。再动
每当你在此行动阶段期间抽牌时，你可以将你手牌中的一张箭矢正面朝上放入你的军械库。
marlynn_treasure_hunter.text_en:
Action - {t}, destroy a Gold you control: Create a Goldfin Harpoon in your hand. Go again
Whenever you draw a card during your action phase, you may put an arrow from your hand face-up into your arsenal.

mask_of_deceit.text_zh:
阿拉克尼专精
当此牌防御时，成为一名随机的混沌特工。若攻击英雄已被标记，改为你选择混沌特工。
刃碎
mask_of_deceit.text_en:
Arakni Specialization
When this defends, become a random Agent of Chaos. If the attacking hero is marked, instead choose the Agent of Chaos.
Blade Break

mask_of_malicious_manifestations.type_zh: 刺客·游侠 装备·头部
mask_of_malicious_manifestations.text_zh:
行动——支付1点资源，将你手牌或军械库中的一张牌置于你的牌库底，摧毁恶意化身面具：从你的牌库顶展示牌，直到你展示一张攻击行动牌。将其置入你的手牌，然后洗牌。再动
刃碎
mask_of_malicious_manifestations.text_en:
Action - {r}, put a card from your hand or arsenal on the bottom of your deck, destroy Mask of Malicious Manifestations: Reveal cards from the top of your deck until you reveal an attack action card. Put it into your hand, then shuffle. Go again
Blade break

mask_of_many_faces.text_zh:
瞬间——支付1点资源，摧毁千面面具：说出一张牌名。本回合你使用的下一张攻击行动牌获得该名称。
刃碎
mask_of_many_faces.text_en:
Instant - {r}, destroy Mask of Many Faces: Name a card. The next attack action card you play this turn gains that name.
Blade Break

mask_of_momentum.text_zh:
每回合一次效果——当你控制的攻击行动牌是连续第三个或更高链环命中时，抽一张牌。
刃碎
mask_of_momentum.text_en:
Once per Turn Effect - When an attack action card you control is the third or higher chain link in a row to hit, draw a card.
Blade Break

mask_of_perdition.text_zh:
当毁灭面具在你坟场中时，在你的回合开始时，你可以摧毁你控制的2个银币。若如此做，装备毁灭面具。
攻击反应——摧毁毁灭面具：目标刺客攻击行动牌获得“当此牌命中英雄时，放逐其牌库顶的一张牌。”
战痕
mask_of_perdition.text_en:
While Mask of Perdition is in your graveyard, at the start of your turn, you may destroy 2 Silvers you control. If you do, equip Mask of Perdition.
Attack Reaction - Destroy Mask of Perdition: Target Assassin attack action card gains "When this hits a hero, banish the top card of their deck."
Battleworn

mask_of_recurring_nightmares.type_zh: 秘法 刺客 装备·头部
mask_of_recurring_nightmares.text_zh:
每回合一次攻击反应——支付3点资源：目标防御英雄放逐其手牌中的一张牌。
刃碎
mask_of_recurring_nightmares.text_en:
Once per Turn Attack Reaction - {c}{c}{c}: Target defending hero banishes a card from their hand.
Blade Break

mask_of_shifting_perspectives.type_zh: 刺客·忍者 装备·头部
mask_of_shifting_perspectives.text_zh: 攻击反应——摧毁变幻视角面具：本回合每当匕首命中时，你可以将手牌中的一张牌置于你的牌库底。若如此做，抽一张牌。
mask_of_shifting_perspectives.text_en: Attack Reaction - Destroy Mask of Shifting Perspectives: Whenever a dagger hits this turn, you may put a card from your hand on the bottom of your deck. If you do, draw a card.

mask_of_the_pouncing_lynx.text_zh:
当你控制的攻击行动牌命中时，你可以摧毁猛扑山猫面具。若如此做，从你的牌库中搜寻一张力量为2或更低的攻击行动牌，放逐它，然后洗牌。本回合你可以使用它。
刃碎
mask_of_the_pouncing_lynx.text_en:
When an attack action card you control hits, you may destroy Mask of the Pouncing Lynx. If you do, search your deck for an attack action card with 2 or less {p}, banish it, then shuffle. You may play it this turn.
Blade Break

mask_of_the_swarming_claw.text_zh:
秘法屏障1
法力虚空X，X为你控制的链环数量。
mask_of_the_swarming_claw.text_en:
Arcane Barrier 1
Spellvoid X, where X is the number of chain links you control.

mask_of_three_tails.text_zh: 瞬间——摧毁此牌：抽一张牌。仅当本战斗链中你命中三次或更多时才能启动此异能。
mask_of_three_tails.text_en: Instant - Destroy this: Draw a card. Activate this ability only if you've hit 3 or more times this combat chain.

mask_of_wizened_whiskers.text_zh:
当此牌防御时，将你坟场中一张具有连击的牌置于你的牌库底。
刃碎
mask_of_wizened_whiskers.text_en:
When this defends, put a card with combo from your graveyard on the bottom of your deck.
Blade Break

massacre.text_zh:
当你用大屠杀攻击时，若本回合你弃置过一张力量为6或更高的牌，大屠杀获得+2力量和威吓。
若大屠杀被弃置以支付蛮将攻击行动牌的费用，威吓。
massacre.text_en:
When you attack with Massacre, if you have discarded a card with 6 or more {p} this turn, Massacre gains +2{p} and intimidate.
If Massacre is discarded to pay the cost of a Brute attack action card, intimidate.

master_cog.text_zh:
传奇
当此牌被资源时，你可以在你控制的一个具有上弦的物品上放置一个蒸汽指示物。
master_cog.text_en:
Legendary
When this is pitched, you may put a steam counter on an item you control with crank.

maul.text_zh:
选择其一或全部；
- 目标基础力量为1或更低的攻击行动牌获得+3力量。
- 目标卧虎获得“当此牌命中时，在你的放逐区中创造2张卧虎。本回合你可以使用它们。”

mauling_qi.text_zh: 连击——当此牌命中时，若卧虎是本战斗链的最后一次攻击，对每位对手英雄造成1点伤害。
mauling_qi.text_en: Combo - When this hits, if Crouching Tiger was the last attack this combat chain, deal 1 damage to each opposing hero.

mauvrion_skies.text_zh:
本回合你使用的下一张符文剑士攻击行动牌获得再动，以及“若此牌命中，创造3个符文吟唱衍生物。”
再动
mauvrion_skies.text_en:
The next runeblade attack action card you play this turn gains go again and "If this hits, create 3 Runechant tokens."
Go again

maximum_velocity.text_zh: 仅当本回合你推进过三次或更多时才能使用此牌。
maximum_velocity.text_en: Play this only if you've boosted 3 or more times this turn.

maxx_nitro.text_zh:
每回合一次行动——支付2点资源：创造一个带有2个蒸汽指示物的超频驱动器衍生物。仅当本回合你推进过时才能启动此异能。
你控制的超频驱动器获得上弦。
maxx_nitro.text_en:
Once per Turn Action - {r}{r}: Create a Hyper Driver token with 2 steam counters.  Activate this ability only if you've boosted this turn.
Hyper Drivers you control get crank.

maxx_the_hype_nitro.text_zh:
每回合一次行动——支付2点资源：创造一个带有2个蒸汽指示物的超频驱动器衍生物。仅当本回合你推进过时才能启动此异能。
你控制的超频驱动器获得上弦。
maxx_the_hype_nitro.text_en:
Once per Turn Action - {r}{r}: Create a Hyper Driver token with 2 steam counters.  Activate this ability only if you've boosted this turn.
Hyper Drivers you control get crank.

mbrio_base_cortex.type_zh: 机械师 装备·基础 胸部
mbrio_base_cortex.text_zh:
若你控制一张超频驱动器，此牌获得+2防御。
守御
mbrio_base_cortex.text_en:
If you control a Hyper Driver, this gets +2{d}.
Guardwell

mbrio_base_digits.type_zh: 机械师 装备·基础 手臂
mbrio_base_digits.text_zh:
瞬间——横置此牌和你控制的一个齿轮：此牌直到回合结束获得+1防御。
淬炼
mbrio_base_digits.text_en:
Instant - {t} this and a cog you control: This gets +1{d} until end of turn.
Temper

mbrio_base_vizier.type_zh: 机械师 装备·基础 头部
mbrio_base_vizier.text_zh:
若你将受到秘法伤害，你可以从你控制的一张超频驱动器上移除一个蒸汽指示物以防止其中1点伤害。
秘法屏障1
mbrio_base_vizier.text_en:
If you would be dealt arcane damage, you may remove a steam counter from a Hyper Driver you control to prevent 1 of that damage.
Arcane Barrier 1

mbrio_base_walkers.type_zh: 机械师 装备·基础 腿部

meat_and_greet.type_zh: 符文剑士 行动·攻击
meat_and_greet.text_zh:
当此牌命中时，创造一个符文吟唱衍生物。
若本回合你对对手英雄造成过秘法伤害，此牌获得再动。
meat_and_greet.text_en:
When this hits, create a Runechant token.
If you've dealt arcane damage to an opposing hero this turn, this gets go again.

mechanical_strength.text_zh: 进化升级——此牌获得+X力量，X为你已装备的进化装备数量。
mechanical_strength.text_en: Evo Upgrade - This gets +X{p}, where X is the number of Evos you have equipped.

medkit.text_zh: 行动——将此牌置于其拥有者的牌库底：获得2点生命。
medkit.text_en: Action - Put this on the bottom of its owner's deck: Gain 2{h}

meet_madness.type_zh: 混沌 刺客 行动·攻击
meet_madness.text_zh:
隐匿
当此牌命中英雄时，随机选择其一；
- 该英雄选择其手牌中的一张牌。放逐它。
- 该英雄选择其军械库中的一张牌。放逐它。
- 放逐其牌库顶的一张牌。
meet_madness.text_en:
Stealth
When this hits a hero, choose 1 at random;
- They choose a card in their hand. Banish it.
- They choose a card in their arsenal. Banish it.
- Banish the top card of their deck.

meganetic_lockwave.text_zh:
目标英雄选择其控制的X件装备，然后你从其中选择1件。该英雄本回合若能够，必须用那件装备防御你的攻击。
再动
meganetic_lockwave.text_en:
Target hero chooses X equipment they control, then you choose 1 from among them. That hero must defend your attacks this turn with that equipment if able. 
Go again

meganetic_protocol.text_zh: 进化升级——防御英雄若能够，必须用其控制的带有-1防御指示物的X件装备防御此牌，X为你已装备的进化装备数量。
meganetic_protocol.text_en: Evo Upgrade - The defending hero must defend this with X equipment they control with -1{d} counters if able, where X is the number of Evos you have equipped.

meganetic_shockwave.text_zh: 防御英雄必须用其控制的X件装备防御磁力冲击波，X为本战斗链中你推进的次数。
meganetic_shockwave.text_en: The defending hero must defend Meganetic Shockwave with X equipment they control, where X is the number of times you have boosted this combat chain.

melody_sing_along.text_zh: 每当你使用歌曲时，创造与游戏中其他英雄数量相等的铜币衍生物。
melody_sing_along.text_en: Whenever you play a song, create Copper tokens equal to the number of other heroes in the game.

melting_point.text_zh:
你本回合的下一次箭矢攻击获得+4力量。
若其带有一个瞄准指示物，它获得“当此牌命中英雄时，摧毁其控制的一件基础力量为1的单手武器。”
再动
melting_point.text_en:
Your next arrow attack this turn gains +4{p}.
If it has an aim counter, it gains "When this hits a hero, destroy a 1H weapon they control with 1 base {p}."
Go again

memorial_ground.text_zh: 将你坟场中费用为2或更低的目标攻击行动牌置于牌库顶。
memorial_ground.text_en: Put target attack action card with cost 2 or less from your graveyard on top of your deck.

mental_block.text_zh: 瞬间——弃掉此牌：防止本回合接下来将对你造成的2点伤害。你第一次以此方式防止伤害时，创造一个沉思衍生物。
mental_block.text_en: Instant - Discard this: Prevent the next 2 damage that would be dealt to you this turn. The first time you prevent damage this way, create a Ponder token.

merciful_retribution.type_zh: 光 幻术师 瞬间·光环
merciful_retribution.text_zh:
每当你控制的攻击行动牌被摧毁时，对目标英雄造成1点秘法伤害。若其为非衍生物光牌，将其置入你的灵魂。
幻尊
merciful_retribution.text_en:
Whenever an aura or attack action card you control is destroyed, deal 1 arcane damage to target hero. If it's a non-token Light card, put it into your soul.
Spectra

merciless_battleaxe.text_zh:
